title: Tsurizao Hitotsu de Isekai Hourou
titleNative: 釣り竿ひとつで異世界放浪
synonyms: Wandering Around Another World with Just One Fishing Rod
synopsis: Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals... (Source: Shinchosha, translated)

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

One day, Tomoya stumbles upon a hidden side to his crush Waka... From the creator of "Class Maid" comes a new love story about an unlucky college student and his crush! (Source: Pocket Comics) Note: Includes 8 extra chapters

synonyms: Uesugi-kun wants to quit being a girl
synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleRomaji: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
titleNative: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
synonyms: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Sorano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side (Source: Yen Press)
